Two River, Mineville

Mineville, Nova Scotia

Concept master plan
PROJECT OVERVIEW

A neighbourhood planned from the ground up.

Also introduced as Notting Hill, Two River is a planned 73-acre residential community in Mineville. The concept includes 54 fourplex lots and 216 residential units.

Illustrative concept master plan. Density, zoning, lot sizes, home dimensions, amenities, layouts and unit counts are proposed, unverified and subject to change. Confirm all planning and sales information directly with Plexus.

LocationMineville, Nova Scotia
Land area73 acres
Concept lots54 fourplex lots
Concept homes216 units
Concept density2.95 units / acre
Illustrative zoningR-1 residential low density
Illustrative lot area10,000–14,000 sq. ft.
VISUAL RECORD

See the project.

Images are identified as construction photography or concept/rendering material.

THE DEVELOPMENT VISION

Looking beyond the site.

The illustrative master plan describes a low-density community organized around green space and walking routes, with access to Highway 107 and Dartmouth. Proposed shared amenities include a central park, clubhouse, community gardens, pocket parks, nature trails, a dog park, a playground and water features. The plan illustrates fourplex homes of approximately 3,000 to 3,500 square feet with four bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, double-car garages, private gardens and decks or patios.

What the published material shows

  • Contemporary fourplex concept
  • Proposed central park and playground
  • Planned nature trails
  • Proposed community gardens
  • Community clubhouse concept
  • Pocket parks and water features
